text.text_excerpt: This review is for the bar only. I did not stay at the hotel. This bar has great happy hour specials on food (fries, boudin balls, margherita pizza) and drinks. I love fries and I was very impressed - might be top 3 for the city. The dipping sauce had an excellent kick to it. We also tried the cornbread (not a happy hour special) which was covered in burrata cheese (looked like frosting) and pepper jelly. Very tasty. The one negative was acoustics - We sat on the chairs & couches since we were in a group and it was hard to hear each other.

I honestly don't know if I would have stopped into this bar if I hadn't stayed at the hotel, but I would be missing out if I hadn't. They have great pizza, drinks and breakfast. The atmosphere is warm and inviting and they have a couple of wooden games you can play at the bar our lounge area. I enjoyed my time spent here.

I am so glad we stayed at the Q&C Hotel, because it is how we discovered the Q&C Bar! This was the first place we grabbed a drink when we started our trip. They had some great draft beer selections. They also know how to make a mean cocktail. We also came here late night. Both times we posted up here we had great service. Their menu is a great value. This place is known for their fresh pizza, if you are going to eat here, get the pizza!! You can actually see the guy throwing dough in the kitchen area soon after you order. We got the supreme and it was delicious. The interior is very welcoming and upscale. Comfy couches are available along with various seating. When we came during the day ...
